description: This file implements contact management functionality for an Android app, including searching and adding contacts via the Contacts API. It defines data classes for requests and contact records, an interface for data source abstraction, a concrete implementation accessing the system contacts, and a handler class managing JSON-based API calls.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact with identifiers, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search query parameters and limit.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating details required to add a new contact.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for contact data sources, including permission checks, search, and add operations.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of ContactsDataSource that interacts with Android's system contacts provider.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has read contacts permission.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has write contacts permission.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for contacts matching the given query and limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact with given details into the contacts provider.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles search request, returns search results as JSON.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles add contact request, returns added contact as JSON.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a ContactsSearchRequest.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a ContactsAddRequest.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Serializes a ContactRecord into JSON format.
